title: Mr. Moonlight
lyrics_synced:
[00:08.99] Mr. Moonlight!
[00:11.37] You came to me one summernight
[00:18.42] and from your beam you made my dream.
[00:24.10] And from the world you sent my girl
[00:31.37] and from above you sent us love.
[00:38.42] And now she's mine!
[00:41.37] I think you're fine 'cause we love you,
[00:47.78] Mr. Moonlight!
[00:52.28] Mr. Moonlight, come again please!
[00:59.56] Here I am on my knees,
[01:02.28] begging if you please.
[01:07.51] And the nights you don't come my way
[01:09.78] I'll pray and pray more each day,
[01:13.42] 'cause we love you, Mr. Moonlight!
